correctness.finding: PASS. The all-step bound is correct. In the CG/Lanczos LDL^T representation, the subdiagonal multiplier at the current pivot is sqrt(beta_k)=||r_{k+1}||/||r_k||. The trailing Schur complement S_k has spectrum in [mu,L]: S_k^{-1} is a principal block of T^{-1}, so its eigenvalues lie in [1/L,1/mu], hence those of S_k lie in [mu,L]. For the leading 2x2 block [[a,c],[c,d]], spectral enclosure gives c^2 <= (a-mu)(d-mu) and c^2 <= (L-a)(L-d); optimizing first in d and then a gives c^2/a^2 <= (L-mu)^2/(4Lmu), attained at a=2Lmu/(L+mu). The diagonal 2x2 equality family gives the same ratio exactly. Independent floating-point tests on random rotated SPD matrices for dimensions 3,5,8 and kappa up to 50 found no violation; the equality family reproduces the constant and the threshold 3+2sqrt(2).
